title: On the eve of the battle for Zaragoza. Alfonso de Oñate has rebuilt his army; Portugal has 11,300 in the field and the Mamlūks 56,000, most of them levies still across the sea, but now with 22 ships where they had one. The mercenaries cost dearly: 123 a month going out against 78 coming in, the treasury at 1,213, and the realm's manpower nearly spent

data.iberia: no town has changed hands since the declaration

source: save of 13 January 1377 (a reading); Trent's account
